name: coinmarketcat
description: COINMARKETCAT — the sniper cat, by Cat Intelligence Agency. It hovers ten seconds over every pump.fun launch and buys only what others followed, inside limits you set. Phantom mode: every trade is one Phantom approval and the extension holds no key. Autopilot mode: an autopilot wallet the extension makes, encrypted under your passphrase and funded from Phantom, signs without asking; your exposure is what you fund it with. Off by default: a second venue that watches new pools pairing a token with an xStock and trades them through Jupiter, paid in that stock, inside its limits.
